gloss: way of making; how to make; recipe

definitions.gloss: way of making; how to make; method of preparation
definitions.explanation: The method or procedure for making something. Used for recipes, crafts, and any process of producing or building a thing.

examples.japanese: ⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作|つく}り{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I learn how to make curry.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作|つく}り{方|かた}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧だ。
examples.english: The way to make this box is simple.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作|つく}り{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧わかる。
examples.english: If you watch the video, the basic method is easy to understand.

notes:
The verb ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make) plus 〜⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (way of doing). This 〜⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ pattern attaches to a verb stem to mean "the way of ~ing."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作|つく}り{方|かた}: how to cook a dish; recipe
- {作|つく}り{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧: to teach how to make something

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧: recipe — specifically for food, listing ingredients and steps
- ⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧: how to use — same 〜⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ pattern with ⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧
- ⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧: method — more abstract and formal
